scope: Completed encountered WikiCS development; repeat optimizer seeds/backbones do not establish independent graph confirmation

mechanisms.name: member_competence
mechanisms.fact: Shared mean members weaker than I4 yet SAGE shared pool can win; exchange strengthens average SAGE member and loses useful coverage/pool accuracy
mechanisms.implication: Do not optimize average member quality alone or make it a universal veto

mechanisms.name: correct_alternative_acquisition
mechanisms.fact: Acquisition is backbone and recipe dependent; SAGE/GCN may increase coverage while GAT loses it
mechanisms.implication: Need correct alternatives and exact introduced harms, not hidden distance

mechanisms.name: pooling_loss
mechanisms.fact: Much original I4-correct/shared-wrong cohort already has a correct shared member; retrieval terminal repairs mostly serve pre-existing alternatives
mechanisms.implication: Serving remains a conditional hook but requires a learnable rule and capable equally processed references

mechanisms.name: common_strict_wrong_rival
mechanisms.fact: Class-independent convex member weights cannot reverse a class that outranks truth in every member; graph scorer empirical repairs zero
mechanisms.implication: Need new useful class rankings outside that fixed scalar mixture, not another scalar router

mechanisms.name: proper_risk
mechanisms.fact: Positive accuracy may retain severe I4 NLL deficit; lower mean NLL may fail the protected per-seed bound
mechanisms.implication: Report accuracy and NLL gates separately, preserve favorable atomic outcomes

reason_no_new_combination: The demonstrated pair is already tested/closed; other cross-family ingredients lack exact common-baseline complementary repairs and proper-risk/reference success. Frozen decoder utility must close first.
pending_decoder: Distinct learned class-score operation and sharing/control question, not a completed positive or new combination nomination
